run_adsorbml: run the AdsorbML pipeline to relax and evaluate adsorbate-slab configurations using a pretrained ML model
adsorb_ml_pipeline: run the ML-based adsorbate-slab pipeline to relax slabs, generate configurations, and detect anomalies
relax_job: run a geometry relaxation on ASE atoms using a calculator and optimizer then return energy and forces
ocp_adslab_generator: generate multiple adsorbate-slab configurations from a slab structure and list of adsorbates
detect_anomaly: detect anomalies like dissociation, desorption, surface changes, or intercalation between initial and final atomic structures
